definitions.dated: Rows carrying a benchmark release date in the frozen census. No proxy, no crawl date.
definitions.facets: Orthogonal properties. A record can appear in several, so these do not sum to the year total.
definitions.l1: Primary capability domain, one per record, so a year's L1 counts sum to that year's dated total.
definitions.min_reliable: Years with fewer than 30 dated records; read their shares as noise.
definitions.mix_deviation: Total variation distance between that year's source mix and the pooled mix.
definitions.population: Every row in benchmark-taxonomy.jsonl, dated and undated.
definitions.reportable_years: Years whose share may be read: enough dated records and a source mix close to the corpus.
definitions.share: That year's count over that year's dated records, not over the whole corpus.
definitions.stratified: Per-source year series. `share_of_year` exposes the changing source mix; `agentic_share` holds the source constant.
definitions.undated: Rows with no release date. They cannot enter any year and are excluded from every share below.
definitions.undated_by_l1: Level 1 composition of the records that carry no release date, so they stay visible on the figure.
definitions.year: The benchmark's own release year. Not a model release, not a crawl day.
